01 Services

Automate, build and maintain

Start with a task you repeat, a tool you need or a system that needs looking after.

Business automation & applied AI

We connect the software you use so information flows between tools. Where AI can help, we use existing models or develop and test a custom AI model for your needs.

  • Sort incoming enquiries and draft replies for your team to check.
  • Move form submissions into your job tracker and set follow-up reminders.
  • Pull relevant information from documents for a research team to review.

Ongoing IT support

Get help maintaining the systems you rely on, including the tools and automations we build for you.

  • Troubleshoot issues when something stops working.
  • Maintain and update your software as your needs change.

Custom software systems

Give your team a shared place to manage jobs, records and approvals, with tools built around the steps you follow.

  • Track jobs from the first request through to completion.
  • Build an approval process around the steps your team already follows.

Websites & apps

Make it easy for customers to find you, browse what you offer or take the next step. Give staff simple tools they can use on the go.

  • Let customers request quotes or book appointments online.
  • Give staff a checklist they can use on their phones.

Business analysis & reporting

Work out which numbers help you make decisions, then bring them together in reports or dashboards your team can use.

  • Automatically prepare a weekly summary of jobs or sales.
  • See open requests and overdue work on one screen.

Social media marketing

We research your market, look at who you want to reach and build a social media strategy around your business goals.

  • Plan what to post, where to post it and how often.
  • Manage and update your Facebook page, X account and Instagram profile day to day.

02 How it works

From your first task to ongoing IT support

We start with how your team works today and agree on what would make the biggest difference.

  1. 01

    Review your workflow

    We look at the steps, tools and handovers involved so we can agree on what to automate, connect or build.

  2. 02

    Build and test together

    We try the new setup with sample work. Your team checks that it fits the way they work before it goes live.

  3. 03

    Keep it running

    We agree on what ongoing support covers and how to get help with a fault, update or change.
